notes: Lodging REIT, not a bank or insurer; the financial sector label fits only loosely as real estate investment.

sub_sector.value: lodging REIT; premium-branded hotels and resorts

financial_business_type.detail: Publicly traded real estate investment trust owning upscale and luxury hotels and resorts, run by operators.

revenue_driver.detail: Hotel revenues from rooms, food and beverage and other guest spending at owned hotels, not interest or premiums.

customer_type.detail: Leisure travelers and business and group guests at hotels in city centers, resorts and conference destinations.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Owns hotel real estate, funded with debt and equity, and recycles capital through acquisitions and sales.
